description: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.

apps.localizedDescription: Beta builds of AnymeX+ (AnymeX with Stremio built in). Installs next to the normal app as AnymeX+ β, with its own sign-ins and library. New fixes land here first.
apps.versionDescription:
Beta v1.1.3-beta+6

- TV app: named audio and subtitle tracks for MKV, search box lets go of the arrows
  - The TV's player doesn't list the tracks inside an MKV, so the panel only had a "next audio track" button. The TV app now reads the start of the file (two small range reads at most; never the whole file) and lists audio as e.g. "English · E-AC3 5.1" with the default one marked, and subtitles inside the video by name.
  - Search: closing the TV keyboard without Enter kept the arrows inside the box. An arrow now leaves the box (and searches what was typed); the keyboard closing does the same.
